scope: Current Russian Post official index definition, address lookup guidance, reference post-office index directory, fixed tariff/post-office API PDF, FNS FIAS/GAR service and update descriptions, and Federal Law 443-FZ were audited without registration, authentication, terms acceptance, provider contact, protected query submission, archive-access bypass, paid service, publication destination or deployment.

countryIdentity.rule: Russia retains repository RU and ledger region Europe. Russian Post, FIAS/GAR, administrative, cadastral and any adjacent-country or region identities remain separate; no source identity, territory or coverage was changed, merged or reassigned.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete six-digit Russian postcode assignment and exception denominator and corresponding valid Polygon/MultiPolygon coverage are usable under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Provider, edition, reference date, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, gaps, conflicts and exceptions are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. Any surface derived from complete address membership is labelled derived and noncanonical. The real RU API/app normalizes the selected six-digit postcode, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; office-only, poste-restante, P.O.-box, organization, military, route, point, temporary, closed, unmatched and other non-area records remain explicit. No post-office point, tariff/dictionary response, FIAS address/map point, street, administrative/cadastral/building/parcel object, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2, and RU/source territorial identity remains unchanged.

officialObservations.finding: Russian Post defines an index as the unique number of the post office to which an address is assigned and instructs users to search an address on the office map. This establishes assignment semantics, not a postal perimeter.

The live page advertises 61,358 current DBF records formed 2026-08-25, covering post-office indices, hierarchy and names, with updates at least monthly. It does not advertise address membership or Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry.

The exact current archive link returned HTTP 417 to both the web retrieval and standard public GET audit; the numbered relative archive returned 404. No bypass was attempted. This proves only audit-time unavailability, not non-existence.

The fixed 67-page API 3.20 PDF documents post-office lookup by index/date. The reviewed postoffice response table lists index, parent, name, type, regional/locality and operational fields, without advertised coordinates, Polygon or MultiPolygon.

FNS describes FIAS/GAR as the unified open federal official address resource. Separate FNS integration guidance describes weekly portal snapshots published twice weekly and API access; FIAS address identity and postcode attributes do not create Russian Post service-area geometry.

Article 8 establishes GAR address information as common-access information published including as open data and required for postal services. It does not publish current assignment rows, postal boundaries or a blanket licence over Russian Post datasets.

rightsAssessment.note: GAR openness applies to exact address information under its legal/data terms; it is not treated as a Russian Post geometry licence. Public page visibility and a download link are not treated as explicit public-serving permission. This is a conservative engineering gate, not a legal opinion.

blockerSummary: Russian Post publishes the current official post-office index directory and defines a postcode as the unique post-office number assigned to an address. FIAS/GAR supplies open official address information and may carry postcode attributes. However, the operator directory is office-grain, the current archive could not be fixed in this audit, the tariff API advertises no area geometry, no official postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release was discovered, and no complete current address-assignment plus exception denominator was inspected and reconciled under explicit postal-area public-serving rights. No real RU runtime, API or map area can be promoted.
unblockConditions: Acquire an exact current Russian Post directory and/or complete FIAS/GAR address-to-postcode assignment plus exception snapshot through ordinary authorized public access, and pin provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, validity, history, coverage and exclusions.

Obtain an exact official Russian Post postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release, or establish a reviewed reproducible noncanonical derivation from the complete current assignment/exception denominator under explicit compatible AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission.

Validate every geometry, topology, gap, conflict and exception; preserve office, address, building, parcel, administration and territory authority separation and invent no office/address point, boundary, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy.
Build an approved immutable artifact and pass real RU six-digit normalization, loader, API, validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
